title: Lisbon travel week 🎂✈️
context: Travel detected automatically: SFO→Munich (layover)→Lisbon Wed 07-22, home Sun 07-26. No bike, no barbell Thu–Sun.
🎂 Birthday Wed 07-22 — flight departs 2:00 PM PDT.
⚠️ Lisbon is 18–34°C vs SF's 12–19°C — you are NOT heat-adapted. All Lisbon running is early + HR-capped, not pace-driven.
Quality rotation: last was ride-vo2 (wk of 07-06, and again 07-13) → this week is run-intervals to get back on alternation.
constraints: Tue 07-21 3:15 PM — Dr appointment (SF) → quality run in the AM
Wed 07-22 — birthday + 2:00 PM flight to Munich → light AM only
Thu 07-23 — in transit / arrive Lisbon, jet-lagged → rest
Fri 07-24 + Sat 07-25 — US meetings land at 1:00–2:00 AM Lisbon time; don't stack a hard AM session on a broken night
Sun 07-26 — travel home (Lisbon→DC→SF, land 8:37 PM) → rest

rest.reason: In transit + Lisbon arrival, jet-lagged. Walk, hydrate, get evening daylight.
Travel home — Lisbon 4:20 AM → SF 8:37 PM. Long day.

philosophy: Travel week = maintenance, not building. Front-load the real work (heavy lift, quality intervals) while still home Mon–Tue.
Running is the travel-friendly mode — it holds aerobic fitness and morning light fixes jet lag fastest.
Heat is the hidden load in Lisbon: 34°C makes a Z2 effort cost Z3. Cap by HR (<153), let pace be whatever it is, and go before 9:00.
Two hard-travel days (Thu arrival, Sun return) are full rest — don't fight it.

events.title: 🏋️ Heavy barbell lift
events.description: Apple Notes squat template: 3×5 @ 225 back squat, 8×255 deep squat, single-leg Bulgarian, pull-ups. Last barbell access for ~10 days. ~55 TSS.

events.title: 🏃 Run intervals (quality)
events.why: Week's quality — back on rotation after two bike-VO2 weeks
events.description: 15' WU. Main: 5×3min @ 4:30–4:40/km (Z4, HR 168–182), 2' jog recovery. 10' CD. AM, before the 3:15 PM Dr appointment. Cool in SF (19–30°C but AM is mild) — good conditions to hit real pace. ~80 TSS.

events.title: 🏃 Easy birthday shakeout run 🎂
events.why: Light before the 2 PM flight — enjoy it
events.description: 40' easy Z2 before packing. Optional. Happy birthday! Getting movement in before 11h of sitting also cuts travel stiffness. ~40 TSS.

events.title: 🏃 Easy Lisbon run (jet-lag reset)
events.why: Morning light resets circadian rhythm fastest
events.description: 40' very easy. GO EARLY — 07:30 start, before the heat (day hits 34°C). Cap HR at 153 and ignore pace; heat inflates HR ~5-10bpm and you're not adapted. Riverside/Tejo is flat and shaded. Carry water. ~35 TSS.

events.title: 🏋️ Hotel dumbbell lift (condensed)
events.why: 2nd strength of the week (>24h from Mon heavy)
events.description: Condensed Hotel Gym DB circuit: goblet squats, DB RDL, DB press, rows, pull-ups if a bar exists. Indoors/AC — heat isn't a factor. Keeps the 2/wk split intact while travelling. ~40 TSS.

events.title: 🏃 Longer Z2 run (Lisbon)
events.why: Weekend aerobic stimulus — no bike available
events.description: 60–75' easy. START 07:30 — 19–31°C day, and you're coming from 12–19°C SF. HR cap 153, walk the Alfama climbs if HR spikes; this is aerobic time, not a hill session. Riverside is flattest + coolest. Carry water, expect pace ~20-30s/km slower than SF for the same effort — that's the heat, not lost fitness. ~70 TSS.
